title: RLPolicy RobotPickPlaceComparison

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the RL policy comparison research task. Analyzed pi_base vs pi_new across 8 metrics in simulation and real-world. Generated comprehensive analysis with 4 Python scripts, 6 visualizations, and a detailed research report. Recommendation: conditional deployment of pi_new with safety monitoring due to efficiency improvements (success rate +2.5-3.2%, cycle time -11%, energy -4-8%) but safety degradations (safety interventions +244-350%, edge case failures +84-86%). All deliverables created in code/, outputs/, and report/ directories.
